blocks.text: Mastering the Outlook interface on Mac

The New Outlook for Mac interface has changed how you manage your inbox. You can toggle between the New and Legacy experiences using the Outlook menu in the menu bar. If you are struggling with missing features, ensure you are running the latest version of macOS Sonoma or later to keep your app updated.

items: Use ⌘ + 1 to switch to your Mail view instantly.
Use ⌘ + 2 to jump to your Calendar for meeting checks.
Use ⌘ + N to draft a new email without touching the mouse.
Use ⌘ + Return to send your message once finished.

blocks.text: Reducing email fatigue in your daily workflow

Email interruptions are a major barrier to deep analysis. Each time you check your inbox, you lose focus. It takes about 23 minutes to return to your previous state of concentration. You should batch your email checks to three or four times per day rather than keeping the window open constantly.

If you find yourself constantly checking for specific client updates, use the search filters in Outlook to isolate threads. Go to the search bar, click the filter icon, and narrow results by sender or subject line.
blocks.title: Search smarter

blocks.text: Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. It sees your screen when you hold the ⌥ ⌘ shortcut. You can ask it to find files, summarize long threads, or guide you through complex app menus. It does not click buttons for you, but it acts as a personal guide to keep you focused on the analysis.

Many credit analysts spend too much time on manual data entry and file assembly. This non-judgment work can occupy up to 60 percent of your day. You should look for ways to automate the extraction of financial figures from PDFs. Tools like MacrosLM or Hebbia are built for this specific purpose. When you are stuck in Outlook, use the built-in rules to sort incoming mail automatically into folders based on the sender or deal name.
Managing deal flow with Outlook tools

Your deal tracker and your email inbox should work together. Use the flag feature in Outlook to mark emails that contain critical credit documents. If you have a shared mailbox for deal intake, ensure it is added correctly to your account settings so you do not miss incoming requests. You can find instructions on how to add a shared mailbox in Outlook on Mac in our help center.
When to use dictation for credit memos

Drafting initial credit memos can be slow when you only use the keyboard. Hold the fn key to use Lazur's dictation. You can speak your thoughts directly into the document. This is often faster for capturing the initial narrative for a credit risk assessment. You can then refine the text with your keyboard once the core ideas are on the page.

faq.question: Can Lazur draft my credit memos?
faq.answer: Lazur can help you dictate text into any document, but it does not write the analysis for you. It is a tool to help you get your thoughts down faster.

faq.question: Does Outlook for Mac support custom keyboard shortcuts?
faq.answer: Outlook for Mac does not have an in-app menu for this. You must set them up in System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > App Shortcuts.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe to use with sensitive financial data?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only processes your screen and audio while you hold the shortcut. It does not store your data or use it to train its models.
